title: Microsoft Teams Has Become a Haven for Scammers in China
summary: Fraudsters are exploiting enterprise chat apps like Teams and Webex to trick Chinese victims into transferring large sums of money, fueling a wave of complaints.

title: What’s next for Avaya?
summary: With a new CEO at the helm, a large installed base and new products in-market and about to land, Avaya has to prove it can innovate.

title: Polymarket reportedly raises $300 million from Donald Trump Jr.’s investment fund
summary: The firm, 1789 Capital, led the funding round that reportedly will total around $1 billion.

title: Google Engineer Accused of Polymarket Insider Trading Says He Was Just Gambling
summary: Michele Spagnuolo was arrested for alleged insider trading on Polymarket, but the Switzerland-based engineer says he was simply gambling—activity that is beyond the reach of US commodities law.

title: Logitech hit by sueball over tariff refunds
summary: Complaint: Peripheral maker did not want to unplug itself from higher prices and hand back cash to customers
